title: At U.N., Trump Says He Will Strike a Deal With Iran or ‘Annihilate’ It
summary_full: President Trump’s statement to the U.N. General Assembly that he could “drive them into hell with no chance of survival” was a jarring departure in a forum devoted to world peace.
